stories.title: Regeringspartij van Poetin leidt bij verkiezingen zonder oppositie in Rusland

en.title: Putin's Ruling Party Leads in Russian Elections Without Opposition
en.summary: Putin's governing party is winning Russia's parliamentary elections with 57.5 percent of votes counted so far, dominating elections that lacked credible opposition candidates.

stories.title: Bij Doema-verkiezingen zonder oppositie gaat Kremlinpartij ruim aan kop

en.title: Kremlin-Linked Party Leads Decisively in Russian Parliament Elections
en.summary: Putin-affiliated United Russia is on track for a commanding victory in Russian parliamentary elections with around 57 percent of votes, while the Communist Party and Liberal Democratic Party follow in second and third place.

stories.title: Acceptatie homoseksualiteit fors gedaald onder jongeren

en.title: Acceptance of Homosexuality Significantly Declined Among Young People
en.summary: Acceptance of homosexuality has dropped substantially among youth in recent years.

stories.title: Acceptatie van homoseksualiteit onder Nederlandse jongens bijna gehalveerd in vier jaar. ‘Zo’n sterke daling hadden we niet verwacht’

en.title: Acceptance of Homosexuality Among Dutch Boys Nearly Halved in Four Years
en.summary: A study of eleven- to sixteen-year-olds shows homosexuality is increasingly viewed negatively, with both boys and girls becoming less tolerant in recent years, attributed partly to negative rhetoric from politicians and influencers.

stories.title: Weer een ‘onmogelijke’ ritzege van Mathieu van der Poel: solo van 177 kilometer in de Ronde van Luxemburg

en.title: Another 'impossible' stage win for Mathieu van der Poel: solo of 177 kilometers in the Tour of Luxembourg
en.summary: Mathieu van der Poel achieved a remarkable victory in the Tour of Luxembourg through an exceptionally long solo breakaway.

stories.title: Deelstaatverkiezingen in Duitsland: opnieuw grote winst voor het extreemrechtse AfD, CDU van Merz keldert

en.title: State elections in Germany: another major gain for far-right AfD, Merz's CDU plummets
en.summary: The Alternative für Deutschland appears to become the largest party in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern following success in Saxony-Anhalt, while left-wing parties in Berlin enable a potential coalition between Die Linke, the Greens, and the SPD.

stories.title: Grote klap voor CDU in Duitse deelstaatverkiezingen, AfD lijkt de grootste

en.title: Major blow for CDU in German state elections, AfD appears largest
en.summary: The CDU, party of Chancellor Friedrich Merz, suffered significant losses in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern state elections, barely clearing the electoral threshold and putting Merz's position under pressure.

stories.title: Haenen stopt na vijftig jaar als stem van Bert, na het overlijden van ‘zijn’ Ernie, Wim T. Schippers, ‘uit eerbied en voor de vriendschap’

en.title: Haenen stops after fifty years as voice of Bert, following the death of 'his' Ernie, Wim T. Schippers, 'out of respect and for the friendship'
en.summary: A voice actor for the character Bert has ended a fifty-year career following the death of the actor who played Ernie.

stories.title: Mathieu van der Poel verbaast wielerwereld met zege na solo van 175 kilometer

en.title: Mathieu van der Poel surprises cycling world with victory after 175-kilometer solo
en.summary: Dutch cyclist Mathieu van der Poel won the final stage of the Tour of Luxembourg through a 175-kilometer solo breakaway, an achievement unprecedented in professional cycling since 2003.

stories.title: Alle 24 verdachten van rellen Malieveld zijn inmiddels vrijgelaten

en.title: All 24 suspects from Malieveld riots have now been released
en.summary: Twenty-four people arrested during a demonstration at Malieveld have been released, though it remains unclear whether they received fines or summonses.

stories.title: Paul Haenen stopt als Bert in Sesamstraat: 'Waar ben je nou Ernie, ik mis je'

en.title: Paul Haenen stops as voice of Bert in Sesame Street: 'Where are you now Ernie, I miss you'
en.summary: Actor Paul Haenen is retiring after over fifty years as the voice of Bert in the Dutch version of Sesame Street, citing the death of his longtime colleague Wim T. Schippers who voiced Ernie. Haenen will also stop voicing Grover.

stories.title: Paul Haenen stopt als Bert uit Sesamstraat na dood collega: 'Waar ben je, Ernie?'

en.title: Paul Haenen stops as Bert from Sesame Street after colleague's death: 'Where are you, Ernie?'
en.summary: Paul Haenen is ending his over fifty-year career voicing Bert in Sesame Street following the death of colleague Wim T. Schippers in June, who provided the voice for Ernie.
